text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: multiple OOMs observed on serving cluster shard kv-reservoir-12 (model: rwd-paged-v2). 4 container crashes and 8 CUDA OOMs in the last 5m. Auto-restart triggered. Starting incident channel.

sarah-ng: copying logs now. early sign: paged-attn allocator showing steady resident growth. looks like fragmentation + slow leak rather than single spike.

devon-l: can you paste the top OOM stack? also which customers hit errors?

sarah-ng: paste logs ->

```
[2026-03-15T22:11:34Z] ERROR runtime: cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T22:12:05Z] WARN kv: page_alloc: unable to coalesce 32KB slab -> fragmentation
[2026-03-15T22:12:45Z] ERROR runtime: allocator: reservation growth to 98% of GPU memory
[2026-03-15T22:13:12Z] ERROR container: exited with code 137 (OOM)
```

sarah-ng: customers: acme-payments prod (increased 503 rate), beta-studio (slow tails). Severity: P2 with customer impact.

jin-ops: ok. immediate plan: 1) enable aggressive eviction on kv cache for shard 12 2) fallback route acme-payments to small-backed model 3) run slab compaction script on drained node.

mike-t: +1. how do we enable aggressive eviction quickly? can we update runtime config per-shard?

devon-l: yes, runtime supports per-shard eviction by toggling env var via kube rollout. I can push a canary to one node first.

sarah-ng: I'll run compaction on two nodes that are already showing high fragmentation. running:
```
./bin/kv-compact --shard=12 --max-duration=120 --dry-run=false
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step 3 triggered: "kv compaction - safe rolling". Expected CPU spike. Notify SRE if GPU memory remains > 90% after compaction.

jin-ops: also enabling prefix/KV cache eviction TTL to 60s for shard 12:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/configs/shards/12 -d '{"kv_eviction_ttl":60}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

mike-t: I've routed acme-payments to rwd-paged-v2-small via smart-routing policy. Traffic shifted 20% -> 100% over 30s. monitoring.

sarah-ng: compaction started on node gpu-12a (pid 4021). progress: 12% -> 48% after 60s.

devon-l: noticed a second pattern: some nodes show repeated small restarts (node flaps). not sure if it's related to host-level oomkiller or container-level fragmentation.

jin-ops: looking at host dmesg on gpu-12b: "Out of memory: KILL process 9312 (runtime) total-vm:..." looks container level but host under memory pressure too.

mike-t: mitigation so far: 1) compaction running 2) eviction TTL lowered 3) traffic fallback. acme 503 rate down to baseline but tail latency still slightly elevated.

sarah-ng: compaction finished on gpu-12a. resident memory dropped 9%. good sign. gpu-12b compaction queued (node is busy).

devon-l: pushing small hotfix: reduce per-request kv prefetch from 4->2 to reduce transient allocations. patch applied to canary.

ops-runbook-bot: Canary deploy result: CPU ok, memory allocations reduced ~18% on canary.

jin-ops: we observed one CUDA OOM during compaction on gpu-12b but container auto-restarted and came back healthy. logging that in incident timeline.

sarah-ng: current status: shard 12 stableish. fragmentation metric trending down but slow. we need longer term: slab defrag in runtime and leak root cause. escalating to ENG_RUNTIME for deeper fix.

devon-l: tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml. @eng-runtime please triage allocator heuristics and verify KV slot accounting. recommended owner: @jin-ops for next 24h runbook.

mike-t: documenting customer impact: acme-payments saw 2.3% error budget burn during the window (22:10-22:25). notified account team.

sarah-ng: handoff for next oncall: state: shard 12 currently on aggressive eviction TTL=60s, fallback routing to small model active, slab compaction done on 2/3 nodes, compaction queued on last node. Observed improvement but watchers required for 3h.

sarah-ng: actions taken: evictions toggled, compaction executed, prefetched reduced, fallback routing enabled. open items: schedule runtime slab-defrag, reproduce leak with stress harness, postmortem if recurrence.

devon-l: leaving logs and commands in /var/log/incidents/3341102468/ and runbook notes in Confluence (link: https://confluence.redwood/eng/incidents/3341102468).

mike-t: assigning follow-up tickets: RWD-5172 (slab-defrag task), RWD-5173 (stress harness reproduction), RWD-5174 (customer follow-up acme). I'll create and link.

jin-ops: thanks team. I'll stay on pager for next 2 hours to monitor, then pass to night oncall with this thread and runbook.

sarah-ng: handing off. summary -> shard 12 mitigated, keep aggressive eviction until slab-defrag shipped, customer impacted but routed fallback. next: eng-runtime deeper triage.

mike-t: :thumbsup: good work. closing active incident channel when stable for 30m. will update postmortem template.

incident-bot: Incident note appended. Metrics window: 22:08 - 22:40. Severity: P2 -> postmortem recommended if recurrence.
